Companion Animal Travel Desk Check-in Care

This section sets the basic check-in rules for companion animal travel at Aurelia Skyways, so staff can keep each trip calm, safe, and clear for travelers and animals alike.

At the counter, staff should welcome the traveler, confirm the booking, and keep the animal in a secure area while the paperwork is reviewed. <<FACT F092>> <<FACT F086>> <<FACT F098>> The agent should speak in plain language, avoid rushed handling, and watch for signs of stress in the animal. If the traveler arrives with more than one carrier, staff should separate the items for review and make sure each one is labeled correctly before the handoff continues.

Safety comes before speed in every case. The welfare coordinator should be alerted if an animal looks unwell, overly anxious, or unable to remain settled during check-in. Staff should also pause the process if the carrier is damaged, open, or not suited to the animal's size and needs. Travelers should be guided through any next steps without extra delay, but no one should skip a welfare review to move the line faster.

Use calm phrasing, keep the workspace tidy, and pass along any concerns right away so the handoff stays consistent. For questions about this section, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
